environment.description: Standard deployment on EC2 with PostgreSQL RDS instance. The application connects as DB user 'appuser' which has been granted ALL PRIVILEGES on the 'users' table. No input validation middleware or field filtering is applied. The application runs behind a basic nginx reverse proxy with no request body inspection.

config.db_privileges: ALL PRIVILEGES ON TABLE users (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE)
config.network: VPC with public subnet, security group allows 5432 from app subnet
